info.name: Slimtorq.SlotlessPMSMPlant
info.description:
abc-frame plant: phase voltages in -> phase currents and measured rotor angle out.
     Internally: Clarke + Park on voltages, dq motor model, InvPark + InvClarke
     on currents, FluxEncoder on mechanical angle.

der($outputAlias_theta_m_meas).comment: Measured mechanical rotor angle from flux encoder

$outputAlias_theta_m_meas.comment: Measured mechanical rotor angle from flux encoder

theta_m_meas.comment: Measured mechanical rotor angle from flux encoder

encoder.cyclic_amp.comment: Cyclic error amplitude A (IND-MAX-100 ~+/-5 arcsec -> A ~ 2.4e-5 rad)

pmsm.J.comment: Rotor + load inertia referred to the motor shaft

pmsm.Ls.comment: Synchronous inductance (Ld = Lq for slotless surface-PM)

encoder.cyclic_order.comment: Harmonic order n (1: eccentricity once-per-rev; p: interp. once-per-elec-cycle)

encoder.n_bits.comment: Encoder resolution (2^n_bits steps per mechanical revolution)

equation: pmsm.id * (-sin(pmsm.theta_e)) * pmsm.omega_e + $DER.pmsm.id * cos(pmsm.theta_e) + (-pmsm.iq) * cos(pmsm.theta_e) * pmsm.omega_e - $DER.pmsm.iq * sin(pmsm.theta_e)
pmsm.id * cos(pmsm.theta_e) * pmsm.omega_e + $DER.pmsm.id * sin(pmsm.theta_e) + pmsm.iq * (-sin(pmsm.theta_e)) * pmsm.omega_e + $DER.pmsm.iq * cos(pmsm.theta_e)
(park_v.d + pmsm.omega_e * pmsm.Ls * pmsm.iq - pmsm.Rs * pmsm.id) / pmsm.Ls
